title: How old is the typical person? Niger, Brazil, the US, Italy and Japan
subtitle: Place five countries on a line by the age of their middle person, then see why Japan, the oldest, was younger in 1950 than Brazil is today.
notes: Swapped India for Brazil (near-identical flags). Niger is one of the youngest (CAR 14.3 is youngest, 2023). Niger passing 30 in 2082 is the OWID/WPP medium projection (30.16 in 2082). True ages drawn as points + numbers after the ask; page valign none so labels clear the caption. Along-scale cards stay small and their row sits below the axis during the ask.
